instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check an entry of signed lines adds to zero and answer it to keep, once per entry id, answer its undo as a new entry with every line negated, and list every entry in the lists that does not add to zero", and give it action; list_id (The list in the request: the source (or the lines, or the row's list) when the body leaves its own list_id out.); lists (The lists the action names, as the caller read them from a store: each { id, row_type, fields, ...the list's own definition, rows: [{ id, values }] } with every row the action reads.).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:post-balanced-entries and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: action post takes lines { amount_field, group_field }, entry_id and rows [{ values }] (two or more); lines that do not add to zero are refused and nothing is answered to keep; the same entry_id posts once.
